messages:
jenna_cs: quick sync 10m about VegaHealth dedicated bring-up. need to lock final quota and confirm autoscale/runbook items.

mike_sre: grabbing shadow logs now, will post a suggested steady qps and burst target within the hour.

diego_eng: their production telemetry shows steady ~1.8k qps, p95 spikes to ~2.6k during morning jobs. recommendation: request 3k steady, 4k burst.

jenna_cs: that matches our earlier convo. two asks: (1) ensure autoscale has headroom for burst + degraded fallback path, (2) enable cache priming before test.

sam_pm: SLA reminder 1 99.9% availability, latency target <300ms for main routes. fallback to smaller model ok for non-critical endpoints. we'll need the fallback policy documented.

ellie_support: I'll build a short oncall cheat sheet on interpreting quota events and surge indicators. also a Loom for the customer SREs.

mike_sre: autoscale proposal: scale-up at 65% GPU util, scale-down at 35%, cool-down 60s. add soft throttle at 85% to avoid OOMs.

diego_eng: agree. also add KV cache warmup step to mitigate cold-cache latency. I'll supply the priming script.

jenna_cs: load test slot: Wednesday 09:00-12:00 PT. plan: warmup + steady + repeated spikes. who owns bastion creds and KMS?

ops_bot: loadjob scheduled placeholder created: lv-1798. KMS attach request open (ticket KMS-4521).

tara_re: legal: data residency is signed off. ops just needs the key policy attached.

loadbot: locust cluster requested: masters x1, workers x8. test id: loc-1798.

mike_sre: test plan sketch:
```
phase 0: priming (KV/cache) 20m
phase 1: warmup 15m @ 500 qps
phase 2: steady 45m @ 3k qps
phase 3: 8 spikes: 1m @ 4k qps spaced 4m apart
metrics: p50/p95/p99 lat, 5xx rate, GPU mem, OOM events
```

jenna_cs: diego please paste priming command and make sure it won't hit PII.

diego_eng: priming script (sanitized): `curl -sS https://vega/prime-list | xargs -n1 -P200 -I{} ./call.sh {}`. will add to runbook and mark as non-PII.

mike_sre: staging smoke at 16:00 PT today. will run reduced profile and share logs here.

ellie_support: enablement note: include exact dashboard panels to watch and the thresholds that should trigger a paging rule.

sam_pm: once smoke is green I'll approve quota bump to capacity team. can we get an ops playbook for fallback rollbacks?

diego_eng: adding a rollback snippet: change route to smaller-model-version, confirm tokens and notify customer. will include in runbook.

ops_bot: quota request submitted: ticket #Q-9342 (3k steady / 4k burst). awaiting capacity ack.

mike_sre: pasted staging smoke summary: `p95=175ms p99=410ms errors=0 gpu_mem=78%` 1 staging looks nominal.

jenn a_cs: (typo) jenna_cs: excellent. I'll loop in capacity team and ops for final attach.

sam_pm: scheduling 30m enablement session with Vega SREs Friday 10:00 PT to walk through runbook and dashboards.

ellie_support: I'll publish the one-page "reading quota events" doc to the enablement pack and attach Loom.

jenna_cs: blockers?

mike_sre: KMS policy attach is the only blocking item. once attached we can run full load on Wed.

jenna_cs: action items recap: (1) capacity team: ack Q-9342, (2) ops: attach KMS policy, (3) diego: upload priming & rollback scripts, (4) mike: run smoke + full load tests per plan, (5) ellie: create enablement artifacts. reconvene post-test for retro. :rocket:
